                max_r = max(max_r, i)
                min_c = min(min_c, j)
                max_c = max(max_c, j)

        return grid

    interior_r0 = min_r + 1
    interior_c0 = min_c + 1
    interior_r1 = max_r - 1
    interior_c1 = max_c - 1
